name: clusters
title: Clusters
about: The unit every view is about. A cluster is a group of features with a similar course over time; it is one node, one bar, one ribbon panel and a value of the table's cluster column.

method.how: k-means on the scaled values of the features (one row per feature, one column per timepoint); the number of clusters is chosen by the user, with an elbow plot as a guide
method.note: values are z-scores per feature, within each sample group when sample groups are given, so clusters group features by shape and not by abundance

features.name: feature_number
features.how: number of features of the cluster that pass the filters

features.name: given
features.how: clusters named in the question, or the ones selected on the page now

features.name: all
features.how: no choice: the answer covers every cluster

target.feature_number: most features, most enriched, largest, dominant; also "the common / typical / main patterns of X": the patterns of the clusters that hold most of X (measure pattern)
target.given: cluster ids written by the user, or the selected clusters
target.all: each cluster, rank, a count over the network

descriptor.feature_number:
"how many features does each cluster contain", "rank the clusters by number of ...",
  "is there a single dominant pattern or are its features spread across many clusters".
